common_inputs.title: Common Inputs
common_inputs.description: Shared input/output and metadata parameters used across workflows.

project.description: Optional project name for external bookkeeping.

phenotypes_dir.description: Directory containing one phenotype file per trait.

summary_stats_dir.description: Directory containing summary statistics; association outputs are linked here for downstream workflows.

grm_dir.description: Directory containing reusable GRM symlinks; pipeline-generated GCTA/LDAK GRMs are linked into gcta_grm/ and ldak_grm/.

max_cpus.description: Global upper bound for CPU allocation per process; resource labels cap requests to this value.

max_memory.description: Global upper bound for memory allocation per process (for example `16.GB`); resource labels cap requests to this value.

workflow_toggles.title: Workflow Toggles
workflow_toggles.description: Enable one or more workflows directly; methods are no longer mutually exclusive selectors.

run_assoc_regenie.description: Enable association testing with REGENIE (step 1 prediction plus step 2 GWAS).

run_assoc_fastgwa.description: Enable association testing with GCTA FastGWA mixed linear model.

run_h2_gcta_grm.description: Enable generation of a GCTA genetic relationship matrix (GRM).

run_h2_ldak_grm.description: Enable generation of an LDAK kinship matrix (GRM).

run_h2_gcta_greml.description: Enable SNP-heritability estimation with GCTA GREML.

run_h2_gcta_greml_ldms.description: Enable partitioned SNP-heritability estimation with GCTA GREML-LDMS.

run_h2_bolt_lmm_reml.description: Enable heritability estimation with BOLT-LMM REML.

run_h2_ldak_reml.description: Enable SNP-heritability estimation with LDAK REML.

run_h2_ldak_he.description: Enable SNP-heritability estimation with LDAK Haseman-Elston regression.

run_h2_ldak_pcgc.description: Enable SNP-heritability estimation with LDAK PCGC regression.

run_h2_ldak_qc.description: Enable LDAK QC and inflation diagnostics workflow.

run_h2_ldak_sumher.description: Enable SNP-heritability estimation from summary statistics with LDAK SumHer.

run_h2_ldsc_h2.description: Enable SNP-heritability estimation from summary statistics with LDSC.

run_rg_ldak_sumcors.description: Enable genetic correlation estimation with LDAK SumCors.

run_rg_ldsc_rg.description: Enable genetic correlation estimation with LDSC.

run_rg_gcta_bivariate_greml.description: Enable bivariate genetic correlation estimation with GCTA GREML.

run_rg_gcta_bivariate_greml_ldms.description: Enable bivariate genetic correlation estimation with GCTA GREML-LDMS.

run_magma_gene_based.description: Enable gene-based association analysis with MAGMA.

run_magma_gene_set.description: Enable gene-set enrichment analysis with MAGMA.

run_lava_local_rg.description: Enable local genetic correlation analysis with LAVA.

run_lcv_causal.description: Enable latent causal variable analysis with LCV.

run_munge_sumstats.description: Run the summary-statistics standardization utility on REGENIE merged outputs.

regenie_skip_predictions.description: Skip REGENIE step 1 predictions and run step 2 with `--ignore-pred`.

phenotypes_apply_rint.description: Apply rank-based inverse normal transformation to phenotypes in REGENIE (`--apply-rint`).

regenie_test.description: Association test model passed to REGENIE step 2 `--test` (for example `additive`).

regenie_force_step1.description: Add REGENIE `--force-step1` to overwrite existing step 1 outputs.

regenie_low_mem.description: Run REGENIE step 1 in low-memory mode (`--lowmem --lowmem-prefix`).

regenie_firth.description: Enable Firth logistic correction in REGENIE step 2 (`--firth`) for binary traits.

regenie_firth_approx.description: Use REGENIE approximate Firth mode (`--approx`) when Firth correction is enabled.

regenie_bsize_step1.description: Block size passed to REGENIE step 1 via `--bsize`.

regenie_bsize_step2.description: Block size passed to REGENIE step 2 via `--bsize`.

regenie_step1_optional.description: Additional CLI options appended verbatim to REGENIE step 1 commands.

regenie_step2_optional.description: Additional CLI options appended verbatim to REGENIE step 2 commands.

kvik_step1_optional.description: Additional CLI options appended verbatim to LDAK-KVIK step 1 (`--kvik-step1`).

kvik_step2_optional.description: Additional CLI options appended verbatim to LDAK-KVIK step 2 (`--kvik-step2`).

genotypes_prediction_chunks.description: Number of chunks for split REGENIE step 1 prediction generation; `0` disables chunked mode.

sumstats_shared.title: Shared Sumstats Columns
sumstats_shared.description: Shared summary-statistics column definitions reused by MAGMA and LDSC.

sumstats_snp_col.description: Column name containing SNP identifiers in summary-statistics input files.

sumstats_a1_col.description: Column name containing effect allele (A1) in summary-statistics input files.

sumstats_a2_col.description: Column name containing non-effect allele (A2) in summary-statistics input files.

sumstats_p_col.description: Column name containing p-values in summary-statistics input files.

sumstats_log10p_col.description: Optional column name containing -log10(p) values to convert into p-values when needed.

sumstats_n_col.description: Column name containing per-variant sample size in summary-statistics input files.

sumstats_n.description: Optional constant sample size to use when per-variant sample size column is unavailable.

heritability_model.description: LDAK heritability model used for kinship and downstream REML, HE, and PCGC analyses (for example `human_default`).

nparts_gcta.description: Number of partitions for GCTA `--make-grm-part` during GRM computation.

gcta_create_sparse_grm.description: Also create a sparse GCTA GRM for FastGWA (`--make-bK-sparse`).

gcta_sparse_cutoff.description: Relatedness cutoff used when constructing and filtering sparse GCTA GRMs for FastGWA.

ldak_adjust_grm.description: Enable LDAK kinship adjustment (`--adjust-grm`) before downstream analyses.

gcta_grm_prefix.description: Prefix of an existing GCTA GRM (`.grm.bin/.grm.N.bin/.grm.id`) to reuse instead of recomputing.

gcta_mgrm_file.description: Path to a GCTA `.mgrm` file listing multiple GRMs for LDMS analyses.

gcta_sparse_grm_prefix.description: Prefix of an existing sparse GCTA GRM (`.grm.sp/.grm.id`) for FastGWA.

ldak_grm_prefix.description: Prefix of an existing LDAK GRM or kinship matrix to reuse.

ldak_adjusted_grm_prefix.description: Prefix of an existing adjusted LDAK GRM to reuse.

ldak_he_subset_prefix.description: Prefix of subset files used by LDAK HE and genotype-error post-processing.

ldak_he_subset_number.description: Number of subset files associated with `ldak_he_subset_prefix` for HE or genotype-error post-processing.

ldak_reml_prevalence.description: Optional disease prevalence (0-1) passed to LDAK REML for binary traits.

ldak_pcgc_prevalence.description: Disease prevalence (0-1) passed to LDAK PCGC `--prevalence` (required for case-control traits).

batch_subset_prefix.description: Prefix of batch subset files used by LDAK QC genotype-error calculation.

batch_subset_number.description: Number of batch subset files associated with `batch_subset_prefix`.

ldak_sumher_tagfile.description: Tagging file required by LDAK SumHer.

ldak_sumher_check_sums.description: If true, keep LDAK SumHer checksum validation; if false, pass `--check-sums NO`.

ldak_sumher_prevalence.description: Global disease prevalence (0-1) passed to LDAK SumHer for case-control traits.

ldak_sumher_prevalence_map.description: Optional file mapping summary-statistics filename to prevalence for SumHer.

ldak_sumher_ascertainment.description: Global ascertainment proportion (0-1) passed to LDAK SumHer for case-control traits.

ldak_sumher_ascertainment_map.description: Optional file mapping summary-statistics filename to ascertainment proportion for SumHer.

ldak_sumher_cutoff.description: Optional cutoff passed to LDAK SumHer `--cutoff`.

ldak_sumstats_liftover.description: Enable liftover and harmonization of summary statistics before LDAK SumHer or SumCors.

ldak_sumstats_target_build.description: Target genome build for summary-statistics liftover.

ldak_sumstats_source_build.description: Source genome build for summary-statistics liftover (`auto` attempts detection).

ldak_sumstats_frq_filter.description: Minimum allele-frequency threshold applied during optional summary-statistics liftover and harmonization.

ldsc_ref_ld_chr.description: Prefix to chromosome-split reference LD scores passed to LDSC `--ref-ld-chr`.

ldsc_w_ld_chr.description: Prefix to chromosome-split regression-weight LD scores passed to LDSC `--w-ld-chr`.

ldsc_h2_extra_args.description: Additional CLI options appended to LDSC heritability command (`ldsc.py --h2`).

ldsc_munge_extra_args.description: Additional CLI options appended to LDSC munging command (`munge_sumstats.py`).

ldak_sumcors_tagfile.description: Tagging file required by LDAK SumCors.

ldak_sumcors_check_sums.description: If true, keep LDAK SumCors checksum validation; if false, pass `--check-sums NO`.

ldak_sumcors_summary_stats1.description: Summary-statistics file for trait 1 in LDAK SumCors.

ldak_sumcors_summary_stats2.description: Summary-statistics file for trait 2 in LDAK SumCors.

ldsc_rg_extra_args.description: Additional CLI options appended to LDSC genetic-correlation command (`ldsc.py --rg`).

gcta_bivariate_phenotype1.description: Phenotype column name used as trait 1 in GCTA bivariate workflows.

gcta_bivariate_phenotype2.description: Phenotype column name used as trait 2 in GCTA bivariate workflows.

magma_reference_plink.description: Reference PLINK prefix used as MAGMA `--bfile` input.

magma_gene_loc.description: Gene location file used by MAGMA annotation step (`--gene-loc`).

magma_gene_results_dir.description: Directory containing precomputed `*.genes.raw` files for MAGMA gene-set analysis.

magma_gene_input_mode.description: Input mode for MAGMA gene analysis: `sumstats` (pipeline summary stats) or `raw` (precomputed raw results).

magma_raw_extra_args.description: Additional CLI options appended to MAGMA raw gene-analysis command.

magma_window_up_kb.description: Upstream gene window size in kilobases for MAGMA annotation (`--window`).

magma_window_down_kb.description: Downstream gene window size in kilobases for MAGMA annotation (`--window`).

magma_gene_model.description: Model specification passed to MAGMA gene analysis via `--model`.

magma_gene_extra_args.description: Additional CLI options appended to MAGMA gene-analysis commands.

magma_set_model.description: Model specification passed to MAGMA gene-set analysis via `--model`.

magma_set_extra_args.description: Additional CLI options appended to MAGMA gene-set analysis command.

lava_analysis_id.description: Output prefix for LAVA result and log files.

lava_ref_plink.description: PLINK file pattern or prefix for LAVA reference LD data.

lava_sample_overlap_file.description: Optional sample-overlap file supplied to LAVA.

lava_univ_threshold.description: Univariate p-value threshold used by LAVA to select loci for bivariate tests.

lcv_analysis_id.description: Output prefix for LCV result and log files.

lcv_ldscores_file.description: Path to LD-score file used by LCV.

lcv_sumstats_trait1.description: Summary-statistics file for trait 1 in LCV.

lcv_sumstats_trait2.description: Summary-statistics file for trait 2 in LCV.

lcv_trait1_name.description: Label or name for trait 1 in LCV outputs.

lcv_trait2_name.description: Label or name for trait 2 in LCV outputs.

lcv_no_blocks.description: Number of jackknife blocks used by LCV.

lcv_sig_threshold.description: Significance threshold used for reporting LCV causal evidence.

lcv_crosstrait_intercept.description: Cross-trait LDSC intercept value used by the LCV estimator.

lcv_ldsc_intercept.description: Single-trait LDSC intercept value used by the LCV estimator.

munge_genome_build.description: Genome build label passed to the summary-statistics munging utility (for example `GRCh38`).

munge_dbsnp_version.description: dbSNP version passed to the munging utility (`0` disables dbSNP-based harmonization).
